title: Sleeping Hot? How Mattress Materials Affect Cooler Sleep
seo_title: Cooler Sleep: Mattress Materials & Heat Build-Up Explained
meta: Why mattresses sleep hot, which materials and constructions help airflow, and how to choose a cooler-feeling bed for warm climates - without unverified “X degrees cooler” claims.
excerpt: Heat is one of the top reasons mattresses fail in real homes. Here is how covers, foams and spring units influence cooler sleep - especially in warm climates.
